# Business Search and SP/GP Registration sample previews are available

_Category: Upcoming Releases · Source: BC Registries API community forum_

**Fareen** (5/30/2022):

For developing Business Search APIs and new registration of Sole Proprietorships or General Partnerships, you can preview a sample of the screens and fields available.  These are currently under development, so subject to change.

* Preview of new [Business Search](https://www2.gov.bc.ca/assets/gov/employment-business-and-economic-development/business-management/permits-licences-and-registration/registries-other-assets/preview_of_the_new_business_search.pdf) User Interface.

* Preview of new [SP/GP Registration](https://www2.gov.bc.ca/assets/gov/employment-business-and-economic-development/business-management/permits-licences-and-registration/registries-guides/screenshots_-_how_to_register_a_sole_proprietorship_and_general_partnership.pdf) flow
